cases.sentence: Пришел в Версавию и принес там ___ Богу.
cases.translation: He came to Beersheba and offered sacrifices there to God.
cases.explain: The transitive verb принести takes its direct object (the sacrifices) in the accusative case.

cases.translation: He offered sacrifices there to God.
cases.explain: The recipient of the offering with принести stands in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Бог говорил с Израилем в ночном ___.
cases.translation: God spoke with Israel in a vision of the night.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating the setting takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into a place takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков со всем своим ___ пришел в Египет.
cases.translation: Jacob came to Egypt with all his offspring.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.
Possession (a list of the descendants) is expressed with the genitive case.

cases.translation: She also bore a daughter, Dinah.
cases.explain: The transitive verb родить takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков послал перед собой к ___ Иуду.
cases.translation: Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph.
cases.explain: The preposition к indicating direction toward a person takes the dative case.

reading.ru: Бог говорил с Израилем в ночном видении и сказал «Иаков, Иаков».
reading.question: How did God speak to Israel?
options: In a vision of the night
reading.correct: In a vision of the night
reading.explain: The text says God spoke 'в ночном видении' (in a vision of the night).

reading.ru: Не бойся пойти в Египет, потому что я произведу от тебя там великий народ.
reading.question: Why should Jacob not fear going to Egypt?
options: God would make a great nation of him there
reading.correct: God would make a great nation of him there
reading.explain: God promises 'я произведу от тебя там великий народ' (I will make a great nation of you there).

reading.ru: Это сыновья Лии, которых она родила Иакову в Падан-Араме.
reading.question: Whose sons does this verse list?
reading.explain: The text says 'Это сыновья Лии' (these are the sons of Leah).

reading.ru: Сыновья жены Иакова Рахили, Иосиф и Вениамин.
reading.question: Who were the sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife?
reading.explain: The text names Rachel's sons as 'Иосиф и Вениамин' (Joseph and Benjamin).

reading.ru: Иаков послал перед собой к Иосифу Иуду, чтобы узнать путь в Гошен.
reading.question: Whom did Jacob send ahead to Joseph?
reading.explain: The text says Jacob sent 'к Иосифу Иуду' (Judah to Joseph) to find the way.

reading.ru: Израиль сказал Иосифу, «Теперь я могу и умереть, потому что увидел своими глазами, что ты жив».
reading.question: Why did Israel say he could now die?
options: Because he had seen with his own eyes that Joseph was alive
reading.correct: Because he had seen with his own eyes that Joseph was alive
reading.explain: Israel says he can die now because he has seen that Joseph is alive.
